title: `getPositionValue()` does not consider accumulated fees
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The function `getPositionValue()` only retrieves the liquidity token amounts using `getLiquidityAmounts()` and converts them into the quote token value.
